## Statistical results

| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| control | 60 | 45 | 6.8 | 0.007002033695484484 |
| treated | 60 | 30 | 11.4 | 0.007002033695484484 |

## Methods

Survival was estimated by the Kaplan-Meier method and compared between groups of arm with the log-rank test (chi-square(1) = 7.27, P = 0.007). Median survival by group: control (median 6.8), treated (median 11.4). Censoring is marked with ticks and the number at risk is tabulated below the curves; it counts the subjects whose time is at or after each time point. Analyses were performed in Python 3.10.12 with lifelines 0.30.0.
